tldr: Recent source-checked launches and research include Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, GPT-6 Cyber, NVIDIA Cosmos 3 interactive models, and LeRobot robotics infrastructure.

Smaller projects are advancing per-harness agent RL, local speech synthesis and schema-directed document extraction; ASR accent testing and bank supervision show continued work on evaluation and governance.
This is a partial November 3-7 catch-up edition: model performance figures are developer-reported, older news is labeled catch-up, and nothing is public until the production publisher validates it.

news.title: OCC outlines bank examination standards for agentic super intelligence
news.summary: The US OCC issued a supervisory framework for bank use of super intelligence and agentic systems, directing examiners to consider existing risk-management principles rather than inventing a separate AI risk category.
news.why_it_matters: Technology-neutral supervision can help banks evaluate agent autonomy, control and accountability in context.
news.caveat: This is supervisory guidance rather than proof of safety or a new binding statute.

sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

news.title: Dharma reports a 2B model for structured field extraction from documents
news.summary: Dharma-AI described a 2B document-image model with LoRA post-training on 43,384 examples that returns schema-directed JSON fields and nested tables.
news.why_it_matters: Specialized small models may reduce the complexity and expense of repeated document intake relative to OCR plus a general model.
news.caveat: Author-selected benchmark comparisons are not independently replicated; weights, licensing and API access for this exact extractor remain unverified.

news.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash expands video length and interactive editing
news.summary: Google announced a generative video model supporting 15-second clips, multi-turn revisions and stronger reference following, stating general availability through its API and enterprise offerings.
news.why_it_matters: Iterative edits can be more practical than regenerating whole clips for production workflows.
news.caveat: Performance claims are Google-reported; the announced 720p cost of $0.07 per generated second may change.

news.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber with security-task scope testing
news.summary: OpenAI announced a cyber-specialized model and reports a 48.5% ExploitGym score against 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber, alongside evaluations of avoiding out-of-scope targets.
news.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the importance of assessing both agent capability and obedience to authorized task boundaries.
news.caveat: Benchmark figures and reports of Firefox and Linux findings are developer claims; guarded defender access does not imply unrestricted availability.

news.title: NVIDIA releases Cosmos 3 checkpoints for interactive simulation
news.summary: NVIDIA detailed four open-weight Cosmos3-Nano checkpoints for controlled video, streaming driving-camera and LiDAR observations, and bimanual robot action prediction.
news.why_it_matters: Interactive sensory prediction can support simulation research for embodied AI and robotics.
news.caveat: The 16B-parameter checkpoints require substantial computation; physical realism and downstream policy benefits remain unproven by the release.

news.title: LeRobot v0.7 adds language-controlled rollouts and streaming datasets
news.summary: LeRobot's v0.7.0 developer notes describe interactive policy sessions, remote inference, streamed training datasets and distributed checkpoints for larger robot models.
news.why_it_matters: Improves workflows for robotics teams limited by onboard compute and very large demonstration datasets.
news.caveat: Compatibility varies across supported hardware, and developer-reported training speedups are workload-specific.

news.title: Gradium details local Phonon speech models and license differences
news.summary: A November 5 article explains Phonon 31m and 40m, compact flow-matching on-device TTS models for private offline use.
news.why_it_matters: Local speech can reduce network dependence and keep input text on the device.
news.caveat: Phonon first launched earlier, not November 5; English 31m is Apache-2.0, while the multilingual 40m has non-commercial restrictions.

news.title: Harness Hub studies per-harness LoRA training with anti-reward-hacking checks
news.summary: An author research release reports RL-trained LoRA adapters specific to pi, opencode and hermes, with verifiable tasks and a rule-based tool-call safety proxy.
news.why_it_matters: Training inside the actual agent harness can expose tool-use failure modes missed by generic instruction tuning.
news.caveat: Reported wins are early held-out smoke-run results; rule-based blocking is not comprehensive security.

news.title: Open ASR Leaderboard gains Egyptian and Nigerian English test splits
news.summary: Hugging Face and Liva AI added private conversational speech splits of 1.34 hours of Egyptian-accented and 1.55 hours of Nigerian-accented English.
news.why_it_matters: Accent-specific tests help reveal performance differences hidden by global ASR averages.
news.caveat: These short private samples are not a representative population study and do not establish a new model winner.

news.title: USDA plans AI checks for November 10 agricultural report
news.summary: Reuters reported that USDA intends to use an internally built AI anomaly checker as an additional validation step for its November 10 crop-production release.
news.why_it_matters: An example of AI quality assurance applied to economically important government statistics.
news.caveat: Use on November 10 was planned but not verified at collection, and the system is a supplement to existing validation.

news.title: CWE-bench v2 exposes 100 verifiable security-repair tasks
news.summary: Collinear AI published 100 public repository-based vulnerability-repair tasks covering 91 CWE categories with programmatic verification and a separate held-out set.
news.why_it_matters: Reproducible agent coding environments offer a stronger evaluation signal than isolated anecdotal repairs.
news.caveat: The public set is access-gated; author-reported model results depend on harness and sampling, and hidden-test content is not public.

technologies.name: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
technologies.explanation: Google API model for generating and iteratively editing videos up to 15 seconds.
technologies.conditional_advantage: Follow-up edits may save rerendering when refining short clips.
tradeoffs: Reference and motion errors require human checks
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Hosted Gemini API; no local weights or consumer VRAM requirement documented.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Proprietary service; applicable account terms need review.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Google reports general availability, but regional/account restrictions were not checked.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: Developer quoted $0.07 per 720p second on Nov 5; changes and secondary costs possible.

technologies.name: Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto
technologies.explanation: Causally distilled model producing successive camera and LiDAR observations from controls and its own generated history.
technologies.conditional_advantage: Conditional synthetic sensory rollouts can support testing driving-policy behavior in changing simulated worlds.
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: 16B trainable parameters; NVIDIA GPU/Linux/container setup; published GB200 use is not a minimum VRAM spec.
technologies.license_uncertainty: NVIDIA identifies OpenMDW1.1; model-specific conditions must be checked.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Open weights linked in official article; support and minimum hardware not confirmed.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: No per-call price asserted; local GPU costs vary.

technologies.name: Phonon 31m
technologies.explanation: Small English flow-matching speech synthesizer intended for offline local inference.
technologies.conditional_advantage: May be effective when speech must work without network access or server text uploads.
tradeoffs: Voice naturalness must be evaluated on target hardware
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Author reports approximately 65 MB and phone/browser support; speed varies by hardware.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Developer says 31m is Apache-2.0; 40m is separately non-commercial.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Previously released open weights, not a new Nov 5 launch.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: No service charge required for local 31m use; user hardware costs apply.

technologies.name: Dharma Field Extractor
technologies.explanation: Developer-described 2B visual model trained with a LoRA adapter for typed, nested JSON field extraction from document images.
technologies.conditional_advantage: Potentially simpler than OCR plus general LLM when repeatedly extracting a fixed schema.
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Authors evaluated on an L40S; minimum VRAM and edge suitability are not documented.
technologies.license_uncertainty: No exact deployable adapter license verified.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Published technical report, but public checkpoint for this exact adapter not verified.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: Reported savings are author-modeled, not verified market pricing.

technologies.name: Harness Hub RL harness adapters
technologies.explanation: Training technique and released adapters fitting a base model to the exact prompts and tools of a given coding-agent harness.
technologies.conditional_advantage: Can improve tool-call efficiency on a stable harness without training a wholly separate full model.
tradeoffs: Results sensitive to task mix and harness version
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Depends on base-model size and chosen RL trainer; no universal VRAM floor.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Verify checkpoint and training-code licenses separately.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Experimental research artifacts and source links, not a maintained managed service.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: Compute cost varies; no set product price stated.

terms.name: Harness adapter
terms.definition: A parameter-efficient model update fitted to one agent runtime's prompts, tools and execution conventions.
terms.mechanism: Train a LoRA adapter with task feedback while the underlying model interacts with that specific harness.
terms.example: Train the same base model separately for pi and opencode, then evaluate each on held-out coding tasks.
terms.caveat: Better performance in one harness does not imply cross-harness transfer or protection against all reward hacking.

terms.name: Self-forcing
terms.definition: Sequence-model training in which later predictions use some of the model's own generated earlier states rather than always clean reference history.
terms.mechanism: Run student rollouts from model-generated context while a teacher or auxiliary signal guides the student to recover from accumulating prediction errors.
terms.example: In interactive video simulation, predict the next video chunk from prior generated frames and current steering controls.
terms.caveat: Does not guarantee stable physics or solve long-range consistency by itself.

terms.name: Schema-directed document field extraction
terms.definition: Extracting a user-specified set of typed fields from a document, rather than reproducing all text as OCR.
terms.mechanism: The model conditions on requested keys/types, reading page layout and producing corresponding JSON with nested entries and missing values where appropriate.
terms.example: Return invoice_number, due_date, total and an array of line_items from a document photo.
terms.caveat: Valid JSON can still carry wrong field values; high-stakes use requires validation.
